description: Fetch the logged-in viewer's meetings and meeting requests, optionally one status bucket. Unfiltered responses include a compact availability summary (merged free ranges per day) unless detail=true. Use my_schedule for the overall timetable and find_meeting_slots to find free times with others.

detail.description: true returns the full availability timeslot grid instead of the summary.

event.description: B2match event URL, slug/euid, or numeric event id.

status.description: Return only this bucket; omit for all buckets.

name: my_meetings
title: Get my B2match meetings
